notes.title: THE UNFINISHED just released ! Also available as a FIREBIRD Bundle
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, and rejoice !

We just released THE UNFINISHED and hope you will like it. We really put a lot of effort in the making of this new episode of the FIREBIRD SERIES, to keep the tone, artistic touch and sensitivity of LA PÉRI while improving many little details and pushing the visuals farther than ever.

For THE UNFINISHED, we worked with the same choreographer than for LA PÉRI, but with two more dancers. 6 characters in the experience required motion capture, and 5 voice actors participated in recording sessions in each language.

Behind those numbers though, we feel like we have achieved to retain the emotion which is at the core of the FIREBIRD SERIES, with a storyline inspired by famous sculptor Auguste Rodin's love story with his apprentice Camille Claudel.

Lastly, expect to have your sculpting skills tested in THE UNFINISHED, but be aware that with the hammer and chisel you will be given, the expression "bring life to the stone" will take a completely different meaning...

Enjoy this new episode of the FIREBIRD SERIES, and if you liked it, don't forget to drop us a comment !

Thanks for your support,

The Innerspace Team

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22321322/fc9da2218e6239f0573975d22c82f1e93089ae34.jpg[/img]

notes.title: NEW EPISODE COMING 29.04.2018 !!!
notes.notes:
Dear all,

We've been greatly touched and honoured by your support and appreciation for FIREBIRD : La Péri, which was released in August 2016. Some of you might even have been part of the Early Release in April 2016 !

So we thought you'd be happy to know that a NEW episode from the Firebird Series will be released in April 2018 :) We are thrilled to finally be able to show it to you all, and welcome you once again in the Firebird theatre !

That's not all though : this new episode is in competition at the Tribeca Film Festival 2018, in the Immersive section ! The team has been hard at work on this new episode and it's amazing to be a part of this prestigious festival - if you are in New York in April, don't miss the opportunity to come see it a few days before it is released.

Lastly, this new episode will be available from day one on the Oculus Rift, HTC Vive and all Microsoft MR headsets via Steam.

From all of us in Paris, a huge THANK YOU for the support, kind words and constructive feedbacks :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22321322/a9bc63e47780a7f0d6a27a788804b78a80c2a77f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: La Péri now on Microsoft MR Headsets !
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are proud to announce La Péri is now available to all Microsoft MR Headset users !

We're thrilled to support these new headsets, just as Steam has opened access to its immersive content to the Microsoft platform through the Steam Beta program.

As usual folks, since this is a musical experience, please make sure your audio devices are properly plugged and active in the Windows sound properties.

And as Thanksgiving approaches, let us express our thanks to you all, for your continuous support of our creations and the overall VR landscape !

A bientôt,

The Innerspace team ːPetalsː

notes.title: Christmas update !!!
notes.notes:
Steam people,

We are thrilled to announce that we pushed a new update which includes a number of fixes and improvements.

Most important new feature is the "VR mode": 
Everyone who has a "Stand up/front facing" setup will now be able to comfortably play "La Peri" within their space without taking the risk to hit their mug to get close to her dance, as we now have implemented a "desk mode"!
People who have more space to play with (like an ideal 3x3m Roomscale), will obviously be able to access the standard "Roomscale mode" within the main menu, and unleash their full choreography!
Also, Oculus Rift with Touch controllers are now compatible.

"La Peri" is part of the Christmas sales, so we have a 50% off, promo until january 3rd!

And last but no least we have a beautiful artwork to celebrate the joy of Christmas with our favorite Dancing Characters.

Hope you will enjoy this update and hope to see you soon on stage with la Peri !


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22321322/d65ede3cec13a7bc0e57bc077c8cde368ed786b4.png[/img]

notes.title: La Peri : what's coming next !
notes.notes:
Hey folks,

we know it has been quite some time we haven't reached you so below is what you need to know about what's coming next.

We will push an important update by the end of the year including [b]Oculus version ( + support for Touch)[/b] and the possibility to play what we call [b]the Standing / Desk mode[/b] for players with limited VR space - the full roomscale requires a 3m² setup.

Also we are thrilled to announce that La Peri won two new awards: "Best Art Direction" at [b]Protoawards[/b] in L.A and "Most Innovative" at [b]FNC eXplore[/b] in Montreal. The store page now features a [b]new trailer[/b] quoting the most laudatory statements from the press.

Thanks again for your support, and please keep posted for the latest news here and at www.innerspacevr.com !

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Firebird - La Peri
notes.notes:
Firebird - La Peri is Now Available on Steam!

Enter a realm of enchantment with "FIREBIRD - La Péri", and play the role of Iskender, a prince seeking the "flower of immortality". You will appear on the stage, visit the ethereal world of La Péri, and witness a magical and poetic encounter as one of the characters... In this unique and visually stunning production by the award-winning french VR studio Innerspace, choreography, music, story-line and the most high-end technology will merge into one, producing an extraordinary audio-visual experience.

notes.title: "FIREBIRD - La Peri" Final Release & Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22321322/d60d20eae6162885c94c980fad14b736777f5bd4.png[/img]

Hi everybody,

we are now reaching the very last steps before going official on Friday 19th of August. As you can see, first of all, the title has changed and we are happy to announce that La Peri now represents the first installment of a musical/choreography series called FIREBIRD - we like to think of as Fantasia for VR.

[b]// Release Notes //[/b]

General

- English voices have been re-recorded with the actor John Rhys-Davies
- French and Mandarin (simplified) languages have been added
- In-game illustrated book acting as a transcript (subtitles) has been integrated
- Launch menu has been implemented with graphics settings option, language selection, restart and shortcut to end-scene dance
- Enhanced graphics (textures, meshes, particules, animations...)
- Enhanced sound (ambient, feedbacks...)
- UI / UX has been made more comprehensive and intuitive
- Implementation of achievements

Minor bug

- Audio play issues when unfocused window fixed

notes.title: Patch Notes - Last update before release
notes.notes:
[b]General[/b]

-  Update to 4.11 (UE4)

 -> hopefully this will fix the issue of the non-working trigger in the tutorial. Please let us know if you still encounter this bug !

- Correction of a few spelling mistakes


[b]Bugs fixing[/b]

- Need to catch twice the bouquet of petals (final choice)

- Wrong positioning of animal spirit petal hitboxes


[b]Visual polishing[/b]

- General ambiance become less dark (especially floor)

- Numerous assets have been reworked

- Stage has been improved visually (details, textures, etc)

- Rework of the in-game controllers, lightorch (left hand) and cage (right hand)

- Particules from caught petals in the cage are now drawing vegetal forms and are graduated in function of player's hand movement speed

- Aura has been added around the bouquet of petals

- Rework of statue modelization and collapse animation

- Modulable skybox during final choice phase


[b]Interactivity[/b]

[i]Intuitivity about actions required:[/i]

- Cage (right hand) is disactivated when not useful

- Setting is destroyed before final act to prevent the player from trying to get petals from the dancer

[i]Petal catching:[/i]

- Animal spirits no longer goes straight on the player 

- Animal spirits animations / reactions are more various

- Chimp petal hitbox has been extended


[b]What's coming next for the final release ?[/b]

- Implementation of an in-game illustrated book on which the voice over will be transcripted (like subtitles). It will also act as a new interactive asset, which gives the ability to the users to decide themselves when they want to go to the next stage.
   
- French, English (new ones) and Chinese voice-over !

- Better transitions in-between scenes instead of fade-to-black

- some mysterious Steam achievements ;)

notes.title: La Peri won "Best Interactive Experience" prize at Kaleidoscope World Tour !
notes.notes:
Hi folk, 

we are pleased to let you know that we have been rewarded with the "Best Interactive Experience" prize of the Kaleidoscope World Tour. 

This latter is a festival exhibiting artistic VR pieces to the public from all over the world in order to help promoting independant VR creators work. 

You can have a look at their website here : http://kaleidovr.com/

See you next year with a whole new project I guess ;), Thanks !
